fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. Joseph says the opposite to the cupbearer: “…I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.” (Genesis 40:15) He also says he was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews. So Joseph is telling the cupbearer that he didn't earn a spot in that dungeon.

Servants carrying things off isn't in the baker's dream, friend. He says the top basket held all sorts of baked goods for Pharaoh, “…but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.” (Genesis 40:17) Birds, with a basket sitting on a man's head, helping themselves. That's the rudest buffet I ever heard of! I'd be waving my mustache and hollering, and I bet the birds would ignore me and keep right on eating.

problems.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
The dream does not mention servants, but it does not say there were none.
